look: Moonfang Alpha, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Quartzbacks family: colossal alpha wolf with crescent-moon quartz fangs, howling. Family anatomy: wolves with frost-quartz spines along the back and pale icy fur. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are frost-white quartz. A grapefruit-sized GKOM core orb, near-black with a liquid shimmer, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, vivid sweeping ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
